goal: Build an Electron GUI app called OpenClack — a silent installer for OpenClaw (https://openclaw.ai). Tech: Electron + TypeScript + React. Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux. Flow: 1. App launches, shows a clean branded UI with OpenClack logo/name. 2. User clicks Install which triggers OS permission prompt (sudo on macOS/Linux, UAC on Windows). 3. User can optionally enter API keys (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.) in a settings form before or after install. 4. App silently handles ALL installation steps in the background: Check/install Node.js >= 22.12 if missing, Run npm install -g openclaw@latest, Run openclaw onboard --install-daemon (non-interactive, pass config), Write API keys to OpenClaw config if provided. 5. Show real-time progress bar and log output during install. 6. On completion, show success screen with Launch OpenClaw button. 7. Handle errors gracefully with retry option. The app should be packageable as .dmg (macOS), .exe/.msi (Windows), .AppImage/.deb (Linux) using electron-builder.
